analysis: The trial timed out after 1,131.02 allocated GPU-seconds and returned no validation score. There are no supplied training logs or per-category results, so training progress, checkpoint completion, and the timeout's cause cannot be established. The code implements 64-negative sampled softmax with updated shape, exclusion, loss-reference, and gradient checks, but their execution is unconfirmed. Larger negative tensors increase computation and memory demand; the available evidence does not show whether they caused the timeout or improved recommendation quality. The earlier macro HR@10 of 0.6062 is historical context, not a result of this trial.
code_summary: Each of four dataset routes trains a separate SASRec and ResidualVAE. SASRec defaults to 64-dimensional embeddings, two causal attention blocks, one head, length 128, and dropout 0.5. Its temperature-one cross-entropy compares each active positive with 64 uniformly sampled negatives, allowing duplicates while excluding the complete training history. ResidualVAE uses a 256-dimensional bag encoder, 64-dimensional latent representation, residual decoder, and reconstruction plus annealed KL loss. Predictions combine both experts using equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion with constant 60. Training uses seed 42, validation-based checkpoint selection, and trial-local artifacts. The generated predictor imports the training architectures, strictly loads checkpoints, and preserves all four dataset routes.
